pattern: びる / びて / びた
purpose: Describe a visible quality resembling a particular stage or condition.
keywords: Established noun/stem + びる / びた / びて
My younger sister suddenly looked grown-up.
The children spoke in a grown-up tone.
formation: Established noun/stem + びる / びた / びて
restrictions: Used in established words such as 大人びる and 古びる.
mistake: Do not attach びる freely to any noun.
